title: Page 3
content_zh:
「一拜天地——」
随着司仪朗喊的步骤，两人一一叩拜。
三拜高堂后，司仪又喊，「送入洞房——」
现场顿时一片欢声庆贺，宾客们纷纷举起酒杯，向今日的主婚人绦威敬贺。
宴席正式开锣，欢笑、祝贺声不断，好不热闹，唯独一个隐藏在角落的男人眼中全是满满的不甘及伤痛，在目送新人入洞房后，落寞的转身离去，却没注意到有个俏丽的人儿在他离去的同时追了上来。
绦岚秋找了好久，总算在新房外找到他的身影。
当她看见瘫坐在亭台里的颓废身影时，心口一阵不舍，让她忘了该有的矜持，快步走上前。
一走近就闻到浓浓的酒气，刺鼻得让她不自觉皱起秀眉，更加担忧那紧闭双眼的男人。
来到他身旁，她蹲下身，察看喝得烂醉如泥的男人，柔声唤道：「竞天哥……你还好吗？」
双眸紧闭的男人没有回应，仿佛早已醉死。
见状，绦岚秋轻咬粉唇。
现在是早春，夜深露重，若是放任他一人在这毫无遮蔽的亭台里睡一晚，肯定会受寒，且今日是紫嫣的喜宴，若是让闹洞房的宾客看见他醉倒在新房外，到时的流言蜚语定会让他更加伤心。
思前想后，她都不舍独留他一人在此，府中的仆人又全集中在前厅招呼宾客，能搀扶他的人，似乎就只剩她……
敛下眼眸，她又喊：「竞天哥，你有听见吗？」
若是能将他唤醒，那是最好不过，但趴在石桌上的男人依旧没有回应。
她的杏眸中有着犹豫，想着要和一个男人如此贴近，绦岚秋不免有些羞怯，更何况这人是她心仪已久的男人。
就在她犹豫不决的同时，远处突然传来宾客的喧闹声及脚步声，这让她心一紧，知道是新郎的亲友要来闹新房。
没时间犹豫了。
心一横，她伸手扶起醉倒在石桌上的封竞天。「唔……好重！」
身材娇小的绦岚秋原本就比封竞天要矮上不只一颗头，加上此时的他完全没有意识，身子的重量几乎全压在她瘦弱的肩上，沉得她险些站不稳。

可重归重，她仍努力拖着他瘫软的身躯，往长廊走去。
绦威好客，府中设有十来间供各地好友前来游玩时休憩、居住的客房，可因为喜宴的缘故，客房全让紫嫣的新婚夫婿敖允的亲友们给占去，目前并没有空房可以安置喝醉酒的封竞天。可就算是有，她也没那力气将他给拖过去，她唯一想到能安置他又离两人最近的地方，就是她的闺房。
她知道这不合礼数，可她已顾不了这么多，一心一意只想尽快将人安置妥当，让他能舒服的度过这对他而言十分痛苦的一夜，至于她，则可以到贴身丫鬟房间窝上一晚。
一段平时不过十来步的距离，绦岚秋这时可是费了好大的气力及时间，才千辛万苦的回到房里。
气喘吁吁的将他给拖上床榻，她连歇都没歇便冲至厨房向大娘要了盆温水。
回到房内，她先将水盆搁在榻旁的矮几上，回身将房门给阖上后，才回到床榻旁，细看榻上那闭着双眸的男人，杏眸里有着浓浓的眷恋。
封竞天不知，今夜伤心的人不只有他，还有她。
她知道他喜欢的是妹妹，今夜是妹妹的大喜之日，他的难过伤心她不会不知，而见他为其他女人落寞伤痛的她，又何尝好过？
敛下眼眸里的不舍，绦岚秋拧来温热的绢帕，轻柔的替他擦拭那俊美非凡此时却憔悴不堪的脸庞。
她以为他早已熟睡，没想到在她轻拭过他狭长的眼眸时，那双原该紧闭的黑眸却突然睁开，带着茫然与她四目相交。
绦岚秋吓了一跳，手上的绢帕滑落在他身上，「竞天哥……你、你醒了？」
她本想替他打理干净便离开，完全没预料他会突然醒来，一时间不知该如何解释。
娇甜的叫唤让封竞天有些迷糊，眯起眼眸想看清眼前的女人，接着嘶哑的叫唤，「紫嫣……」
闻言，绦岚秋身子一僵。
「紫嫣……」他坐起身，蓦地将她抱住，「我就知道……我就知道你不会这么狠心嫁给别人……」
他无预警的一抱把绦岚秋整个人给紧紧拥入怀中，两人之间密不可分，她的一张粉脸羞得通红。
「竞天哥，你认错人了……」她轻扭身子，想拉开两人过于贴近的距离。
「不，别离开我！」
生怕她离开，封竞天非但不放，反倒搂得更紧，那力道险些让她喘不过气。
「竞天哥……」她努力屈起双手，抵住他的胸口，想让他看清自己不是他所想的人，「我是岚秋，不是紫嫣，你清醒点。」

「岚秋？」他努力凝聚涣散的目光，凝视着紧抱在怀中的娇人儿。
那黛眉、那杏眸、那挺鼻以及那粉嫩的樱唇，怎么看都是他心里的人儿，她明明就是他的紫嫣。
「紫嫣、紫嫣！你休想骗我，我不会再放开你……」
「竞天哥，我说了我不是……快放开我……」
烈酒让封竞天意识不清，任凭绦岚秋怎么解释，他不放就是不放，最后竟一个翻身，将她带上床榻，吻住她微启的香唇。
这突如其来的变故让绦岚秋瞪大杏眸，一颗心因这亲密的接触猛地狂跳。
「紫嫣……」吻着那朝思暮想的芳唇，他再也克制不住连日的思念，探手轻解她的衣带。
那一夜，不只新房传出新人相拥喘息的声息，这儿也是……
第2章(1)
回想起那一夜，绦岚秋依然觉得甜蜜，就算她只拥有他一夜，就算次日一早，他那惊讶不信的神情伤害了她，她仍不后悔。
她虽不悔，却没想过封竞天的感觉。
要是她知道那一夜会让他如此懊恼悔恨，就算用尽一切办法，她也不会让那件事发生，只是一切都已经来不及了……
敛下眼中的难过，她回过神，看着竹儿忙碌的身影，轻声问：「都收拾好了吗？」
竹儿停下动作，埋怨的看着她，「小姐，咱们真要搬到那个地方去吗？」
绦岚秋没回答，而是站起身，用行动表示自己的决心，「若是收拾好了，那就走吧！」
她率先走出她和封竞天的新房，往宅第的西侧走去。
竹儿见状，只能嘟囔暗骂，连忙背起装着衣物的包袱，随着主子的脚步而去。
封竞天休了她，虽答应让她留下，可万万不可能让她继续留在他房里，于是他将她赶到宅子的西侧，佣人房旁的小院落「观月阁」。
观月阁原是封竞天及妹妹封书滢的奶娘所住的院落，年迈的奶娘返乡后，这儿就一直空着无人居住，于是他把此处作为她未来一年的住处。
封竞天休妻一事无人知晓，可想而知新婚隔日，绦岚秋主仆俩带着大大小小的行李来到观月阁，会引起多少仆役的侧目，那一道道猜疑、探索的目光，宛如芒刺在背。

「那不是爷的新婚妻子？怎么会在成亲的次日来到这儿？」
「瞧她身后的丫鬟还背着包袱，该不是做了什么有失妇德的事，让爷给赶了出来？」
「失德？爷成亲不过才一夜，难不成……」
听着众人的指指点点，竹儿可没有绦岚秋那样沉着，气愤的低喊，「小姐，那可恶的男人分明是故意让你难堪！」
封府这么大，可恶的封竞天却让她们住在仆人房的旁边，府中仆役少说有百余人，就算她们出入再怎么小心，也不可能避开所有人的耳目，他分明是故意要羞辱小姐。
content_en:
"Worship the heaven and the earth——"
Following the steps shouted by the master of ceremonies, the two people kowtowed one by one.
After three bows to the high hall, the master of ceremonies shouted again, "Sent into the bridal chamber——"
The scene burst into cheers and celebrations, and the guests raised their glasses to congratulate today's officiant, Sui Wei.
The banquet officially started, and there were constant laughter and congratulations. It was very lively, except for a man hiding in the corner whose eyes were full of unwillingness and pain. After watching the newlyweds enter the bridal chamber, he turned around and left lonely, but did not notice that there was a pretty person chasing after him as he left.
Qian Lanqiu searched for him for a long time and finally found him outside the new house.
When she saw the decadent figure slumped in the pavilion, she felt a sense of reluctance, which made her forget her proper restraint and quickly stepped forward.
As soon as she got closer, she could smell the strong smell of alcohol, which was so pungent that she frowned unconsciously, making her even more worried about the man with his eyes tightly closed.
When she came to his side, she knelt down, looked at the drunk man, and called softly: "Brother Jingtian... are you okay?"
The man with his eyes closed did not respond, as if he was drunk to death.
Seeing this, Guan Lanqiu bit her pink lips.
It was early spring, and it was late at night. If he was allowed to sleep alone in this uncovered pavilion for one night, he would definitely catch the cold. Moreover, today was Zi Yan's wedding banquet. If the wedding guests saw him drunk outside the new house, the rumors would definitely make him even more sad.
After thinking about it, she was unwilling to leave him alone here. All the servants in the palace were gathered in the front hall to greet the guests. It seemed that she was the only one who could help him...
Lowering her eyes, she shouted again: "Brother Jingtian, did you hear me?"
It would be best if he could be awakened, but the man lying on the stone table still didn't respond.
There was hesitation in her almond-shaped eyes. Thinking about being so close to a man, Qi Lanqiu felt a little shy, not to mention that this man was the man she had long admired.
While she was hesitating, the noise and footsteps of guests suddenly came from the distance, which made her heart tighten. She knew that it was the groom's relatives and friends who were coming to have a wedding ceremony.
There was no time to hesitate.
Heartbroken, she stretched out her hand to help Feng Jingtian, who was lying drunk on the stone table. "Hmm...it's so heavy!"
The petite Wei Lanqiu was already more than a head shorter than Feng Jingtian, and since he was completely unconscious at this time, the weight of his body was almost entirely on her thin shoulders, making her almost unable to stand still.
But again, she still tried her best to drag his limp body towards the corridor.
Sui Wei is hospitable, and the mansion has about a dozen guest rooms for friends from all over the place to rest and live in. However, due to the wedding banquet, all the guest rooms were occupied by relatives and friends of Zi Yan's newlywed husband Ao Yun. Currently, there is no vacant room to accommodate the drunken Feng Jingtian. But even if she did, she didn't have the strength to drag him over. The only place she could think of to place him and be closest to the two of them was her boudoir.
She knew it was not etiquette, but she couldn't care so much anymore. She only wanted to put the person in place as soon as possible so that he could comfortably spend this very painful night for him. As for her, she could spend the night in the personal maid's room.
A distance that usually only lasted about ten steps, but Guan Lanqiu spent a lot of effort and time to get back to the room.
Panting, she dragged him to the bed. Without even taking a break, she rushed to the kitchen and asked her aunt for a basin of warm water.
Returning to the room, she first placed the basin on the low table next to the couch, turned around and closed the door, then returned to the bed and took a closer look at the man with his eyes closed on the couch. There was deep nostalgia in his almond-shaped eyes.
Feng Jingtian didn't know that it was not only him who was sad tonight, but also her.
She knew that he liked his sister, and tonight was her sister's big day. She would not know how sad and sad he was, and how could it not be easier for her to see him lonely and sad for other women?
Suppressing the reluctance in her eyes, Sui Lanqiu twisted the warm silk handkerchief and gently held it for him.Wipe that handsome and extraordinary face that is now haggard.
She thought he was already asleep, but she didn't expect that when she wiped his narrow eyes, the black eyes that should have been closed suddenly opened and met hers with a look of confusion.
Guan Lanqiu was startled, and the silk handkerchief in her hand slipped and fell on him, "Brother Jingtian... you, are you awake?"
She wanted to clean up for him and leave, but she didn't expect him to wake up suddenly, and she didn't know how to explain it for a while.
The sweet call made Feng Jingtian a little confused. He narrowed his eyes to see the woman in front of him clearly, and then called hoarsely, "Zi Yan..."
Hearing this, Guan Lanqiu stiffened.
"Zi Yan..." He sat up and hugged her suddenly, "I knew... I knew you wouldn't be so cruel to marry someone else..."
Without warning, he hugged Gui Lanqiu tightly into his arms. The two of them were inseparable, and her pink face turned red with embarrassment.
"Brother Jingtian, you have recognized the wrong person..." She twisted slightly, trying to distance the two of them from being too close.
"No, don't leave me!"
Afraid of her leaving, Feng Jingtian not only refused to let go, but hugged her even tighter, the force almost making her breathless.
"Brother Jingtian..." She tried her best to bend her hands and put them against his chest, trying to make him see that she was not who he thought she was. "I am Lan Qiu, not Zi Yan. Please wake up."
"Lan Qiu?" He tried hard to gather his scattered eyes and stared at the charming girl tightly in his arms.
That dark eyebrow, those apricot eyes, that straight nose and those pink cherry lips, no matter how you look at it, she is the person in his heart. She is obviously his Zi Yan.
"Zi Yan, Zi Yan! Don't even try to lie to me, I will never let you go again..."
"Brother Jingtian, I told you I'm not...let me go..."
The strong alcohol made Feng Jingtian unconscious. No matter how Guan Lanqiu explained, he would not let go. Finally, he turned over, took her to the bed, and kissed her slightly parted lips.
This sudden change made Guan Lanqiu's almond-shaped eyes widen, and her heart beat wildly due to this intimate contact.
"Zi Yan..." Kissing the fragrant lips that he had longed for, he could no longer restrain his thoughts for days and reached out to gently untie her belt.
That night, not only could the sound of the newlyweds hugging each other and breathing come from the new house, but also from here...
Chapter 2(1)
Recalling that night, Qian Lanqiu still felt sweet. Even if she only had him for one night, even if his surprised and disbelieving look hurt her early the next morning, she still would not regret it.
Although she didn't regret it, she never thought about Feng Jingtian's feelings.
If she had known that that night would make him so regretful, she would not have let it happen even if she tried her best, but it was already too late...
She suppressed the sadness in her eyes, came back to her senses, looked at Zhu'er's busy figure, and asked softly: "Is everything packed?"
Zhu'er stopped moving and looked at her complainingly, "Miss, do we really want to move to that place?"
Qi Lanqiu did not answer, but stood up and expressed her determination with actions, "If you have packed up, then let's go!"
She took the lead to walk out of her and Feng Jingtian's new house and walked to the west side of the mansion.
Seeing this, Zhu'er could only mutter and curse secretly, quickly picked up the bag containing clothes, and followed his master's footsteps.
Feng Jingtian divorced her. Although he promised to let her stay, he could never let her stay in his room, so he drove her to the "Guanyue Pavilion", a small courtyard next to the servant's room on the west side of the house.
Guanyue Pavilion was originally the courtyard where the nanny of Feng Jingtian and his sister Feng Shuying lived. After the old nanny returned to her hometown, the place had been empty and uninhabited, so he made this place her residence for the next year.
No one knew about Feng Jingtian's divorce from his wife. It was conceivable that the day after the wedding, when the master and servant Guan Lanqiu came to Guanyue Pavilion with luggage of all sizes, they would attract many servants' sideways glances. Those suspicious and probing eyes were like thorns on their backs.
"Isn't that my new wife? Why did she get married on the first day of marriage?Come here today? "
"Look at the maid behind her still carrying a baggage. Could it be that she did something unbecoming of a woman and was kicked out by me?"
"Unethical? I only got married for one night. Could it be possible..."
Listening to everyone's pointing fingers, Zhu'er was not as calm as Guan Lanqiu. She shouted angrily, "Miss, that hateful man clearly deliberately embarrassed you!"
The Feng Mansion was so big, but the hateful Feng Jingtian let them live next to the servants' room. There were at least a hundred servants in the manor. No matter how careful they were in and out, they couldn't avoid everyone's eyes and ears. He clearly wanted to humiliate the young lady on purpose.
